pages.name: Dutch: 2.Bg5 h6
pages.notes: Plan 1 exchanged on f6 with no knight there and attacked f5 with g4; plan 2 pushed ...g5 onto the bishop. Rewrote both plans around Bh4, ...g5 Bg3 and ...f4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Bg5 Nf6
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 had ...exf6 open the e-file and ...gxf6 prepare a light-squared fianchetto; plan 3 developed Nc3 then Qc2 (blocked by the c-pawn; reviewer catch). Rewrote overview phrase and plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Nc3 d5 3.Bg5
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 traded the bishop for a knight not yet on f6, then fought for e5 that a black pawn on f6 would cover (reviewer catch); plan 4 broke a pin that does not exist. Rewrote overview phrase and plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Nc3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 2 read White's e4 break as a Black move. Reworded plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Bg5
pages.notes: Overview called Bg5 a pin on f6 (the e7-pawn blocks the line); plan 1 fought for e5 after an exchange that leaves a black pawn on f6. Rewrote overview sentence and both plans.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Bg5 d5
pages.notes: Overview called 3.Bg5 a pin (the e7-pawn blocks); plan 3 broke that pin with ...g5 onto the bishop, then offered ...e6 alongside an e-pawn recapture on f6 (reviewer catch). Rewrote overview phrase and plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Bg5 d5 4.Bxf6 exf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 called e5 a light square (and the f6-pawn covers it), then played c2-c4 with the knight on c3 (reviewer catch); plan 4 played ...d6 with the pawn on d5 and rerouted the light-squared bishop to g7 or h6 (dark squares). Rewrote overview phrase and plans 1, 2, 4.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Bg5 d5 4.Bxf6 exf6 5.e3
pages.notes: Overview called the f-pawns isolated (the g7-pawn stands beside them) and the e-file open; plan 1 played c2-c4 with the knight on c3 and called e5 a light square. Rewrote overview phrase and both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Bg5 e6
pages.notes: Plan 2 proposed a queenside storm with ...b5-b4; plan 4 pushed ...g5 onto the bishop. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Fianchetto Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 read the e4 break as a move from the wrong side; plan 2 likewise. Reworded plans 1-2; British spelling.
